svg.title: Weekly npm downloads of each protocol main SDK
svg.desc: Line chart on a log scale. MCP 89.5M a week; A2A 6.8M a week; x402 649K a week; MPP 520K a week; Web Bot Auth 243K a week; UCP 13K a week; KYA-OS 15K a week; x401 487 a week
svg.text: Weekly npm downloads of each protocol's main official SDK
Log scale, 2 Jun 2025 to 9 Nov 2026. Each line starts at the first week with downloads. Downloads include CI and mirrors.
